raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (327 rows, ingested 2026-01-18) was delivered with source_tz='UTC', while every other batch is America/Chicago local time. Its first sample row is at 12:00 UTC, which is 06:00 CST, so its evening transactions spill into 2026-01-18 00:00-06:00 and land on the wrong txn_date. The fix converts UTC-sourced timestamps to America/Chicago local time before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) s WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
